Usage guidance

When to use

A segment switch toggles between 2–5 mutually exclusive states of a single setting or mode — in Copilot, the Chat / Cowork / Code switcher. The continuous track reinforces toggling within one control; use Tabs instead when each option reveals a different content panel.

Do
  • Keep exactly one segment selected; slide the indicator on change.
  • Reserve the semibold width (ghost node) so selection doesn't reflow.
  • Use Equal width for peer options; Mixed for a label + icon actions.
  • Limit to 2–5 short segments.
Don’t
  • Use it to switch between content views — that's Tabs.
  • Exceed 5 segments or use long labels that wrap.
  • Allow zero or multiple selected segments.
  • Fill the track with a heavy color — the white indicator carries the weight.
